acceptanceEvidence: src/lib/desk-navigation.ts adds Website to the More list for owner and admin only (tests/vc4-website-editor.test.ts proves STAFF, CUSTOMER and signed-out get no entry; tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts updated); src/app/desk/settings/website/page.tsx opens on an overview with the live version and time, the draft change count and the four tasks; requireRole("OWNER","ADMIN") guards the page and every action, proven for staff, customers and signed-out in tests/vc4-website-editor.test.ts and, at the domain, in tests/vc4-website-editor-integration.test.ts (staff, deactivated owner, unknown user).

workspace.tsx lists pages by familiar names (pages.ts) with changed counts and a search box over every item; phone flow is page, then section, then edit with an Edit/Preview switch (hidden/xl classes), side by side from the xl width; tests/vc4-website-editor-ui.test.tsx covers search and navigation; e2e/website-editor.spec.ts scans overview, editor, photos, review and history at 360/768/1440 in light and dark for sideways scrolling and accessibility (runs in CI).

field-editor.tsx shows where an item appears, what is live and what is proposed, shared places, when it takes effect, the counter and limit, the facts a sentence may use, separate link words and destination, the picture library with upload, description, decorative choice, focus sliders and crop previews, and promotion on/off with Colorado start and end and a visible-now sentence; values are validated by the same rules at save (tests/vc4-website-editor-ui.test.tsx, tests/vc4-website-editor.test.ts for Colorado time round trips).

src/app/website-preview/route.ts (404 for anyone but an active owner/admin, validated page, version and moment, redirect to the public page with ?select=1), request.ts (marks words only for owner/admin who asked), preview-markers.ts and preview-bridge.tsx (marks removed after load, click reports the item to this website's origin and previewed version only), HeroPicture data-site-key for the home photo, the workspace message handler (origin, version and key checked) and a keyboard list; tests/vc4-website-editor.test.ts, tests/vc4-preview-bridge.test.tsx and tests/vc4-website-editor-ui.test.tsx prove these; no marks exist on the public site (e2e checks the preview text for marks; visitors always get selectable false).

The action bar in workspace.tsx offers Save draft, Preview and Review N changes with honest states; a failed save keeps what was typed and shows the error (component test), a double press saves once (component test), a changed-elsewhere draft is refused with a reload button (STALE_DRAFT_MESSAGE, tested at the domain and in the browser spec), leaving with unsaved changes asks via the browser prompt and an in-screen confirm.

review-panel.tsx shows before and after for every change with link destinations and picture thumbnails, the business facts used with their current values, blocking problems and pages affected (getDraftReview, tests/vc4-website-editor-integration.test.ts); publishDraft needs the draft version and the live version reviewed, refuses if either moved, and a repeat or simultaneous publish succeeds as already live without publishing twice (real-Postgres tests, component test for the double press); after publishing it links to the live pages.

history-panel.tsx lists versions; restoreRevisionToDraft puts a version in the draft (never live), replaces an open draft only when the screen knew about it, and is blocked with a plain message for a removed picture; discardDraft needs the draft version; all are audited (tests/vc4-website-editor-integration.test.ts, tests/vc4-website-editor-ui.test.tsx for the replace warning and confirmations).

Controls are labelled, lists and buttons are keyboard operable, errors appear in an alert region that takes focus, and the component tests run the automated accessibility scan on every field kind, review and history; e2e/website-editor.spec.ts runs the full scan at phone, tablet and desktop widths in light and dark in exact-head CI.

src/domains/site-content/template-contract.ts lists 204 content slots (key, kind, longest text, optional), 14 facts owned elsewhere and 5 structure slots, typed by hand; tests/vc5-template-contract.test.ts proves it equals the editor in both directions (kind, limit, optional), that every slot has exactly one owner, that each fact placeholder has exactly one other owner, and that the committed fingerprint and the template version must be updated on purpose.

planCompatibility() in template-contract.ts is pure: it maps renamed keys, reports retired, renamed, newly required and unconvertible items, keeps retired content aside, fills nothing over written content and never edits a stored revision (tests/vc5-template-contract.test.ts).

tests/fixtures/site-content/schema-v1.json and schema-v2.json are saved examples of each content format; the tests read both through the codec, check every slot resolves, and show customized content surviving a layout change and a rollback (identical values after change and back).

The same test file is the release rule in the normal CI unit run: it fails if the layout cannot show the last supported content format or a slot changed without the fingerprint and version being updated; docs/runbooks/WEBSITE-TEMPLATE-ROLLBACK.md gives the owner-proof change and rollback steps.

tests/vc4-website-editor.test.ts proves visitors, staff and customers always get the live words and the real time whatever revision, previewAt or select they send (the draft reader is never called), that marks appear only for an owner/admin who asked, and that the preview door returns 404 with no draft wording for everyone else; e2e/security-response-headers.spec.ts adds that only public pages opened for select-to-edit may be framed and the door is 404 for a visitor.

externalAcceptance: Browser and accessibility checks of the new Website screens (overview, editor, review, history at 360/768/1440 in light and dark), the select-to-edit click path and the framing header rule run in exact-head CI; a production build cannot be made in the local sandbox (Google Fonts are blocked), so the browser spec has not been run locally. Component tests with an automated accessibility scan cover the same screens locally.

Real use after the daily release: pictures need the private picture store configured in production; website picture bytes are still not in the daily recovery media copy and picture cleanup is unscheduled (carried from V-C2).
Owner decision (not blocking): the Website entry is in the More list; it can be promoted to a main menu entry if preferred.
The preview shows the site's current opening mode, so the before-opening home variant is visible in the preview only while the site is in prelaunch mode.
evidence: Bundle V-C4+V-C5; planning commit c042d74b85172c4d7e5e9d4997363ae804f392f9 preserved.

Local: typecheck, lint, wording, secrets, route-inventory and shard checks pass; 16 unit tests (permissions at every action, review diff, marks, Colorado time round trips across both daylight-saving changes, preview door, anonymous-draft behaviour), 13 component tests with an automated accessibility scan (words, link, picture, promotion, review, history), 10 contract tests, 8 real-Postgres tests; the full run passes apart from the earlier custody Denver-date test and an unrelated tax-transition unhandled rejection that appears only in the full parallel run and passes alone; exact-head CI pending.
